user_query: trass gmail with term mgm last 2 months

intent.goal: search trass gmail for emails involving mgm

generated_query:
SELECT DISTINCT
    u.page_id,
    u.workspace,
    u.database_name,
    u.title,
    u.created_time,
    g.subject,
    g.sender_name,
    g.sender_email,
    g.message_content
FROM unified_content u
JOIN gmail_content g ON u.page_id = g.page_id
WHERE u.workspace IN ('trass')
AND u.database_name = 'gmail'
AND (
    g.subject LIKE '%mgm%'
    OR g.sender_name LIKE '%mgm%'
    OR g.sender_email LIKE '%mgm%'
    OR g.message_content LIKE '%mgm%'
)
AND (
    g.email_date >= date('now', '-2 months')
    OR u.created_time >= date('now', '-2 months')
)
ORDER BY u.created_time DESC
LIMIT 1200;
